title: Mortgage Loan File Compliance Standard: Booking a Zero-Tolerance Cure Before Consummation
content:
**Standard.** For the zero-tolerance bucket of a Mortgage Loan File before consummation, and only for it, Larkspur measures the zero-tolerance charges as last disclosed on a Loan Estimate against the good-faith baseline and books any cure as a lender credit at closing. The cure is booked as one entry in the `zero_tolerance` bucket naming the initial Loan Estimate as the baseline disclosure and the latest Loan Estimate on the file as the disclosure measured, with cure method `credit_at_closing`; where the cure works out to nothing, no cure entry is booked. For the zero-tolerance cure assessed before consummation, and only for it, the initial Loan Estimate stays the baseline disclosure and the increases that a changed circumstance accounts for are taken out of the measured increase instead of re-setting the baseline.

**When the cure is assessed.** A zero-tolerance cure is assessed only after the latest Loan Estimate on the file carries the changed circumstance documented most recently on the file. Where the latest Loan Estimate on the file does not yet carry the most recently documented changed circumstance, no zero-tolerance cure is assessed on the file.

| Element of the cure entry | Value |
|---|---|
| Tolerance bucket | zero tolerance |
| Baseline disclosure | the initial Loan Estimate on the file |
| Disclosure measured | the latest Loan Estimate on the file |
| Cure method | a lender credit at closing |
| Timing | before consummation |
| Cure that works out to nothing | no entry is booked |

## Booking tool: `assess_tolerance_cure_d5e015cb`

**Capability.** Books a TRID tolerance cure that Larkspur owes the borrower on a Mortgage Loan File. One call adds one assessed cure to the file's tolerance cure history, dated today, for the tolerance bucket, the baseline and measured disclosures, the amount and the delivery method given, and raises the file's balance of cures owed to the borrower by that amount. The borrower and the agent can then see the cure owed in the file's tolerance cure history.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `assess_tolerance_cure_d5e015cb` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `loan_file_id` — the reference number of the Mortgage Loan File the cure is owed on, as returned by the loan file lookup.
- `tolerance_bucket` — the tolerance bucket the cure belongs to: `zero_tolerance` (charges that may not increase at all — Larkspur's charges, transfer taxes, services the borrower could not shop for) or `ten_percent_aggregate` (charges that together may increase by no more than ten percent — recording fees and shoppable services chosen from Larkspur's written provider list).
- `baseline_disclosure_id` — the reference number of the Loan Estimate whose amounts are the good-faith baseline, as listed in the file's disclosure history.
- `final_disclosure_id` — the reference number of the disclosure whose amounts are measured against the baseline, as listed in the file's disclosure history or returned when that disclosure was issued.
- `cure_amount` — the cure owed to the borrower; US dollars, a positive number with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent, no currency symbol.
- `cure_method` — how the cure reaches the borrower: `credit_at_closing` (given as a lender credit on the Closing Disclosure at closing) or `post_closing_refund` (refunded to the borrower after the loan has closed, with a corrected Closing Disclosure).

**Return.** A one-line confirmation of the form "Tolerance cure <cure entry id> assessed on loan file <loan file id>: <bucket>, baseline <baseline id>, measured <measured id>, <amount> USD by <method> on <YYYY-MM-DD>.", where the cure entry id is the new entry's reference number, the bucket, ids and method are the values passed in, the amount has 2 decimals and the date is today's date. Receiving this line means the cure is booked as owed.
